_readme: 风洞 3D 车漆表（wind3d.js 读）。color 是 sRGB 车漆色；metal/rough/clearcoat 给 three.js 的 MeshPhysicalMaterial；spec 是底漆自己的反光强弱（深色漆主要靠清漆层反光，调低免得发灰）；glow 是这色在光圈里时风线的颜色；sw 是色片的 CSS 背景。

credit.zh: 3D 模型：「2025 Xiaomi SU7 Ultra」by Dave Love SketchFab，CC BY 4.0（Sketchfab）；去掉了赛车涂装和尾翼字样，改了车漆、轮毂和卡钳颜色。纽北原型赛车，非在售车型。
credit.pl: Model 3D: „2025 Xiaomi SU7 Ultra” — Dave Love SketchFab, CC BY 4.0 (Sketchfab); usunięto malowanie wyścigowe i napis na skrzydle, zmieniono lakier, felgi i zaciski. Prototyp torowy z Nürburgringu, nie model w sprzedaży.
credit.en: 3D model: “2025 Xiaomi SU7 Ultra” by Dave Love SketchFab, CC BY 4.0 (Sketchfab); racing livery and wing lettering removed, paint, wheels and calipers changed. Nürburgring track prototype, not a car on sale.
